caption: The drawing depicts a small, stylized object resembling a mouse, rendered in shades of gray pencil on a light beige background. The mouse-like figure has a rounded, elongated body with a long, slender tail curving upwards and to the left. Its head is pointed with a short snout, round ears, and small, rounded eyes. Positioned beneath its body are two crossed cylindrical shapes resembling sticks or bones, which the mouse-like figure appears to be standing on. The composition is centered within a rectangular border, and there is a handwritten signature reading “G. Capelli” in the lower right corner inside the border.
title: Mouse
